_meta.description: Official Adobe brand assets, bundled with the skill. Source files supplied by Adobe employee via Marketing Hub.
_meta.canonical_source: Adobe Marketing Hub > Corporate Brand > Logos (Adobe SSO required)
_meta.changelog: 2026-07-17: symbol-red/white/black.svg (+png) replaced. They previously rendered the bare/untiled 'A' glyph directly in colour, which is the RETIRED presentation. The current official Adobe mark is the self-contained app-icon tile — red rounded square + white glyph, adobe-icon.svg — used as-is regardless of background, never recoloured. Explicit user instruction: never use the old bare icon again.

wordmark-red.use_when: Default Adobe corporate mark on white/light backgrounds

wordmark-white.use_when: Adobe mark reversed out on color or dark backgrounds. Most common in vision demos.

wordmark-black.use_when: Adobe mark on light photography or when red unavailable

adobe-icon.description: THE modern Adobe mark: self-contained app-icon tile, red rounded square (#EB1000) with a white glyph. This is the canonical source file for symbol-red/white/black below.
adobe-icon.use_when: Any compact Adobe mark — app headers, favicons, footer chips, nav bars. Used as-is on any background; it carries its own tile, so it is never recoloured per surface.
adobe-icon.do_not: Do not strip the rect and use the bare path alone — that is the RETIRED presentation. Do not hand-draw or approximate the glyph; if you need it at a different size, scale this file's viewBox, don't redraw the path.

symbol-red.description: Alias of adobe-icon.svg, kept under the legacy filename for existing {{adobe_symbol_path}} references. Identical content to symbol-white/symbol-black — the tile is not recoloured.
symbol-red.use_when: Compact contexts where wordmark is too wide. App headers, favicons, footer chips.

typography._note: Adobe Clean is a LICENSED font. Adobe employees can use it on https://fonts.adobe.com/fonts/adobe-clean via Adobe Fonts CDN, but cannot redistribute font files. The skill embeds fonts via Adobe Fonts kit URL, NOT by bundling .woff2 files.
typography.kit_setup_instructions: Adobe employee creates a Web Project at fonts.adobe.com adding Adobe Clean + Adobe Clean Serif. Copy the kit URL (e.g. https://use.typekit.net/XXXXXXX.css) and store in vision-demo-skill/references/typography.md. The kit URL is embedded in every demo's HTML <head>.
typography.fallback_when_no_kit_url: If no kit URL is available, fall back to font-family: 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif. Source Sans 3 is open-source and Google-Fonts-hosted; embed via <link rel='stylesheet' href='https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Source+Sans+3:wght@200..900&display=swap'>
